text_block_list.text: Yes, it's our time, Sigurd! Behold, the true radiance of destruction... And the ultimate power to forge a new future!

新たな未来を創造する
究極の力だ！

text_block_list.text:

THE ULTIMATE END BLAZE ETERNITY WORLD CATASTROPHEEE!!!
